svg.title: Batch upsert latency over time in the published Qdrant 1.12.6 benchmark
svg.desc: Batch upsert latency over time in the published Qdrant 1.12.6 benchmark The original published data marks are retained as a raster layer. Their positions and counts are unchanged. Axes and legends are editable SVG. Raw numerical logs are unavailable.
svg.metadata: Source: 2.png; SHA256: e35d454e3538eb708f16e8797d6d7ea786240fdc6d267b875d63037ac0dd6ae8. Crop: (87, 43, 800, 339). The color transform changes presentation only; it does not reconstruct numerical observations.
